desc:
UPDATE v1.0 - THE XP UPDATE
- NEW: XP and levels! Earn XP from crashes, air time, coins and every hazard you dodge or get hit by
- Skill chains multiply your XP
- Level up to unlock new cars
- Your old wins were turned into XP
- New finish line with a slow-mo replay
- NEW: Fling All - throw every other racer into the air
- NEW: Buckskin horse skin
- Map vanishing fixed, better on phones

Race through 7 hazard sections and try to make it to the finish line. Dodge UFO tractor beams, lasers, sweepers, trains, squeeze walls, stampedes and more.

- 4 maps: Plains, Desert, City and Beach (harder maps give more wins)
- Vote for the next map in the lobby
- Grab coins and unlock cars in the Garage: Horse, Monster Truck, Chrono Coupe, Neon Cycle, Orange Tabby and more
- Special rounds: Tiny Racers, Tank Battle, Pure Driving, Combo Sections
- Play on PC, phone, tablet or with a controller

Out of beta - thanks to everyone who tested! More maps, cars and hazards are on the way.
